independence.statement: All numeric findings below were re-derived either (a) from first principles (the composite-gate false-stop-rate arithmetic, 1-(1-alpha)^6 and its pass-probability complements) before checking them against CORR-20260831-d663e0's own text, or (b) by directly loading the archived raw-result.json files and the frozen implementation/*.py source under experiments/EXP-MONO-b19c6b/implementation/ (read as-is, never edited) and recomputing quantities the execution_report.yaml/CORR text summarize but do not itself show in full (e.g. all 760 raw per-curve p-values, per-family field_bits distributions, prime-only collision counts). No archived summary or the Coordinator's own correction record was taken on faith for a numeric claim; every quoted number in the report was independently recomputed from the raw JSON or the source code.
independent_pieces: Extraction of all 760 raw per-curve p-values (stage2 + stage3, both families, both statistics, both runs) directly from raw-result.json, with counts below nominal 0.05 compared against the null-expected rate
Spearman correlation between p_var_raw and p_cf_raw across 380 curve-arm-stage cells, to quantify effective test independence
Fisher exact tests for a field_bits enrichment pattern among p<0.05 hits, computed pooled and split by stage (null-object vs real arm) as a self-applied null-object control

1-(1-alpha)^6, (1-alpha)^6, and their squares (both seeds) for both the original and Bonferroni-corrected (alpha/6) readings of the Stage-2 composite gate, re-derived from first principles before reading CORR-20260831-d663e0's own '~26.5%' figure
Direct re-extraction of p_collision/B_collision/t_used_collision/full_triple_collision counts from both runs' stage1_independence_verification.comparisons arrays

Direct verification of p=1(mod 3) admission for every realized j0 curve and the trace-of-Frobenius supersingularity check for every realized random-ordinary curve from primary_panel_curve_records, independent of the archived boolean flags
Cross-run prime-match comparison at matched curve_ordinals to confirm master_seed genuinely varies the realized panel
Direct reading of run_experiment.py's Stage-4 code to confirm the extended dual-path sample's actual selection rule
Cross-check of stats.py's chi2_sf_even_df against scipy.stats.chi2.sf over 200 random (x,df) pairs, plus an original synthetic positive-control test of fisher_combined_pvalue

raw_pvalue_audit.conclusion: No excess of nominally-significant results; slightly below null expectation. Holm/Fisher summaries are not masking a near-boundary result.

field_bits9_exploratory_pattern.conclusion: Not significant after correction; appears comparably in the null-object arm (no real effect possible by construction) as in the real arm, so read as benign instrument texture, not signal. Exploratory, not evidence.

alpha_inflation_sharpening.conclusion: CORR-20260831-d663e0's arithmetic (~26.5% false-stop rate) and its check against the archived data are both confirmed correct and independently reproduced; additionally, a well-calibrated instrument had only ~54% (not ~90%+) a priori chance of passing the flawed gate on both seeds, so the bare gate-pass event alone is weaker evidence of calibration than face value suggests, though the specific observed statistics remain far from either threshold under any reading.

family_independence_residual.conclusion: Zero full-triple collisions confirmed independently in both runs, matching the archived claim exactly. A small, undisclosed prime-only collision rate (~6.5%) exists, expected given the small prime pool at 7-11 bit sizes, benign (B differs in every case), but never surfaced in the prose.

admission_rules_verified.conclusion: Both admission rules verified directly from persisted (p, N) pairs, independent of the archived boolean flags. No violation found.

master_seed_panel_independence.conclusion: Confirmed genuinely different panels per run (small-prime-pool coincidence only, not a shared stream), fixing EXP-MONO-670aa6's total shared-panel defect.

stage4_coverage_gap.declared_selection_rule_literal_reading: every draw_index congruent to 0 mod 100 in [0,20000), i.e. up to 200 positions per curve
stage4_coverage_gap.implemented_selection_rule: draw_index in {0,100} only, plus the curve's null-object-pick draw
stage4_coverage_gap.conclusion: Satisfies the declared '>=200 total samples' floor via curve-count multiplication of a thin, fixed prefix, not via within-curve range coverage; a narrower recurrence of EXP-MONO-670aa6's own dual-path coverage gap, not a fresh closure of it. No actual disagreement found in the samples that were checked.

fisher_combined_positive_control_gap.conclusion: Arithmetic confirmed correct; synthetic check confirms the machinery can reject given concentrated signal, but no run in this three-experiment lane has ever exercised Fisher's method against this contract's own known-exceptional construction (subgroup/coset-union). The mandatory K5 nearby-object control is discharged for the reused per-curve Var/permutation computation but not for the new co-primary Fisher-combined metric.
